title: NIST WebBook: Nitrous oxide is N2O, molecular weight 44.0128 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Nitrous oxide as N2O, molecular weight 44.0128 amu, CAS 10024-97-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Nitrous oxide, CAS Registry Number 10024-97-2, lists molecular formula N2O and molecular weight 44.0128 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 44.0010626292 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/N2O/c1-2-3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
